meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Reviewed both Support and Enterprise response adapters preserving current role policy, answers, trace/evals and actor-owned JSON history while using only published knowledge for UI.

auth.review_note: Checked owner-only administration, CSRF guards, scoped MCP digest records and revocation, and private guide access across both agent surfaces.

commerce.review_note: Reconciled issued document sequence exports against stored invoice evidence and checked protected MCP sales aggregates against dashboard definitions.

content.review_note: Reviewed public ProductService and BlogService published selection and exclusion of future, draft, retired or private Markdown and paths.

foundation.review_note: Reviewed safe public REST A2UI route, generated maps, version 1.0 envelope, bounded components and unchanged database/chat schema.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed layout script ordering for A2UI renderer and WebMCP alongside Google analytics integrations without changing consent or credential tags.

http-errors.review_note: Validated bounded A2UI endpoint errors and fallbacks without leaking exceptions, session contents or untrusted HTML.

interface.review_note: Reviewed strict A2UI 1.0 Basic subset catalog IDs, flat components, bindings, same-origin openUrl, and no generated HTML or unsafe function execution.

mail.review_note: Reviewed read-only A2UI card presentation and verified no mailbox, SMTP, queue or customer message side effect.

mcp-clients.review_note: Reviewed the WebMCP A2UI read-only schema and omitted credentials; existing owner-issued MCP grants remain private.

media.review_note: Reviewed A2UI Card/Text/Link renderer: no new media upload, image fetch, cross-origin URL or active-reference deletion.

operator-help.review_note: Reviewed owner-only help, role-gated admin chat and shared public presentation: no private Markdown guide enters public A2UI.

sales-channels.review_note: Checked public product visibility, published navigation destinations and isolated first-party catalogue and policy discovery.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed post-main 60-second Hostinger wait, exact SHA confirmation, isolated cart acceptance and independent live WebMCP-A2UI tool invocation.
